pull-request-footer:
- Merging this PR triggers `build-and-publish.yml` (chained from `release-please.yml`) to build desktop binaries (macOS arm64/x86_64, Linux x86_64, Windows x86_64), package archives with SHA256 sums, and attach assets to the draft release. The git tag is created up front (`force-tag-creation: true`) so the chained build has a stable anchor before the release is published.
- Do not edit `CHANGELOG.md` manually — release-please owns it. The version lives in `Cargo.toml` and reaches the binary through `env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")`, so there is nothing to hand-edit and no build-time injection.
- Each release carries its own BSL Change Date, four years from publication. Check `LICENSE` is correct for this version before merging.
- To skip a release, close this PR; release-please will reopen it on the next merge to main.
